purpose: Follow-up semantic consistency review and documentation clarifications; no science/runtime/schema change
retention: All listed compact validation artifacts are committed; prior tooling result already committed.

review.method: Same-model separate source/requirements review in the same context; not independent-model endorsement or termination proof

findings_resolved.ambiguity: A private accepted line-search step could be confused with a committed physical endpoint.
findings_resolved.direction: Search remains private; full physical gates apply to substep/hour acceptance. Short-circuit cheap failed gates; do not compute unused Jacobians.

findings_resolved.ambiguity: Fatal model exit could be interpreted as ending the autonomous worker.
findings_resolved.direction: Simulator stops; worker retains evidence and continues diagnosis or unblocked prerequisites.

findings_resolved.ambiguity: Parent reproduction could bypass the unchanged-failure experiment guard.
findings_resolved.direction: Reuse captured evidence or materially change the diagnostic measurement/fixture; renamed runs or prose-only hypotheses do not suffice.

findings_resolved.ambiguity: Existing sanctioned normalization might be read as an exception to no clipping.
findings_resolved.direction: Removed that wording; no helper/DEV bypass. Require conservative represented nonnegative endpoint and independent closure.

findings_resolved.ambiguity: Fewer evaluations could become an inappropriate requirement for every safety repair.
findings_resolved.direction: Stall repair demonstrates eliminated wasted work or bounded valid completion; safety guards may add justified bounded cost.

findings_resolved.ambiguity: Complete hazard coverage could delay every local repair until a model-wide rewrite.
findings_resolved.direction: Focused cycles validate affected paths; all remaining coverage remains required before release.

findings_resolved.ambiguity: Floor preservation and frozen-rule language could prevent evidence-based repair of an invalid rule or legacy defect.
findings_resolved.direction: Preserve verified semantics by default; independently derive missing/proved-invalid definitions, retain old failures, test held-out cases and freeze before qualification.

capability_gap.finding: Current F3 has no invalid-reference disposition; both raw streams must be finite and satisfy direct comparison rules. DEV attribution alone cannot pass it.
capability_gap.evidence: raw_evidence.py finite() and outputs() call finite on both values; qualification_reports.py requires zero nonfinite/outside_rule.
capability_gap.direction: If an actual reference-model defect is proved, first implement and test a versioned evidence contract preserving all raw coverage, requiring independent scientific resolution and retaining normal valid-reference checks. Keep F3 unqualified meanwhile; no unchanged reruns or invalid Zig acceptance.
capability_gap.status: Conditional implementation prerequisite explicitly documented, not implemented or claimed resolved by these edits.

residual_limits: Static checks cover links/vocabulary/aliases, not all semantic conflicts.
No claim that all future scientific blockers or runtime stalls are impossible.
Worker runtime remains UNQUALIFIED; this review does not activate it.

validation.reuse_reason: Only instructions/aliases changed; suite dependency hashes remain valid. New doc/skill checks validate current text.
